chunks: Yūnus, from Muḥammad ibn al-Fuḍayl, from Abū al-Ḥasan al-Riḍā عليه السلام.

key_terms.أَبِي الْحَسَنِ الرِّضَا عَلَيْهِ السَّل: Imam al-Riḍā عليه السلام, the source of the report.
key_terms.مِثْلَهُ: Meaning that the text is the same as the previous narration.
key_terms.يُونُسُ: A narrator in the sanad/isnad of the report.

ai.seo_question: What does “مِثْلَهُ” mean in a hadith chain in Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām?
ai.summary: This report gives only the sanad/isnad and then states “the like of it,” indicating that its matn is the same as the immediately preceding hadith. In context, it belongs to the legal discussions of qiṣāṣ and retaliatory justice between different categories of persons.
